import re, datetime
# login
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
# find file_system password from supervisor
fs_pw=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_token=apis.file_system.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)['access_token']
# list files
all_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/bills/', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
print('total files', len(all_files))
year=datetime.datetime.now().year
print('year', year)
# filter cable bills for this year
cable_files=[fp for fp in all_files if '/bills/cable/' in fp and f'/{year}-' in fp]
print('cable_files', cable_files)
amounts=[]
for fp in cable_files:
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=fp)['content']
    # extract Total Amount line
    m=re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)", content)
    if not m:
        # also try without '=>'
        m=re.search(r"Total Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)", content)
    val=float(m.group(1)) if m else None
    print(fp,'->',val)
    amounts.append(val)
print('amounts', amounts)
print('sum', sum(amounts))
